findings.evidence: Pre-PR ColorDecomposition: `colorSingletProj N := ((N : ℂ)⁻¹ • traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ).smulRight 1` vs new `tracePart g := ((Fintype.card n : K)⁻¹ • (traceLinearMap n K K ∘ₗ mulLeftLinearMap n K g⁻¹)).smulRight g`; removed `completeOrthogonalIdempotents_...`: `rw [colorOctetProj_eq]; exact .of_isIdempotentElem isIdempotentElem_colorSingletProj` vs new `rw [tracelessPart_eq_one_sub]; exact .of_isIdempotentElem isIdempotentElem_tracePart`; removed `trace_colorOctetProj`: `rw [colorOctetProj_eq, map_sub, trace_colorSingletProj, LinearMap.trace_one, Module.finrank_matrix, Module.finrank_self, Fintype.card_fin]; push_cast; ring` vs new `trace_tracelessPart` (MetricTrace.lean:224-229) with the identical script; orthogonality lemmas reuse the same `IsIdempotentElem.mul_one_sub_self` / `one_sub_mul_self` route.
findings.fix: Add a sentence to the module docstring, e.g. 'This generalizes the colour singlet/octet projectors `colorSingletProj`/`colorOctetProj` of `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Quarkonium.NRQCD.ColorDecomposition` from the metric `1` to an arbitrary metric `g`', and extend the `Authors:` line to include the contributors of that module.
findings.issue: The file is an extraction/generalization of the colour singlet-octet projector algebra of EpsilonEridani/QFT/Quarkonium/NRQCD/ColorDecomposition.lean (authored by 'The EpsilonEridani contributors'), but the docstring credits only Isometry.lean and Ji, and the header claims sole authorship. The PR description's novelty check names Mathlib/Physlib/PhyslibAlpha/TauCeti and omits the in-repo predecessor it generalizes.

summary: External sources (Ji 1995 ×2) and the Isometry conventions are credited in both module docstrings. But MetricTrace.lean is a close generalization of the existing in-repo projector algebra in QFT/Quarkonium/NRQCD/ColorDecomposition.lean — same definition shape, theorem order and proof scripts — with no mention of that origin in the file or the PR description.
